editorial.blurb: A Chicago institution for four decades, Taquerías Atotonilco serves authentically crafted tacos and tortas that keep locals coming back for the quality meat and fresh-made drinks.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the carne asada or al pastor tacos and ask for fresh juice or horchata—reviewers consistently praise the quality of the meat and the house-made beverages, especially when you arrive during their extended hours from morning to late night.
